correctness.rationale: PASS: The final claim covers every normal complex 3x3 A, every complex B and the Haar complex unit sphere. In the eigenbasis of A, squared moduli are Dirichlet(1,1,1) with E[P_iP_j]=1/12, i!=j, and directed off-diagonal phase monomials are mutually orthogonal. Noncollinear eigenvalues determine P from the complex numerical value and leave exactly sum_{i!=j}|b_ij|^2/12. Three distinct collinear eigenvalues give fiber T=rP_2+P_3, with P_2 uniform on [0,L_r(t)], density 2L_r(t), E Var(P_2|T)= (1/6)integral_0^1 L_r(t)^3 dt=1/24. The residual diagonal coefficient is D=b22-(1-r)b11-r b33. For repeated spectra conditional Haar symmetry within eigenspaces yields the Hilbert-Schmidt projection Pi_A and residual norm squared/12. Affine diagonal residual is |D|^2/(12H_r), H_r=1+r^2+(1-r)^2, and H_r/2>=3/4; the r=1/2 diagonal example attains equality while a noncollinear epsilon perturbation gives zero risk. Independent exact rational fiber check confirmed three r values; this is a mathematical fiber integration, not Monte Carlo proof.
